agents_page.check_type_tcp_hint: Sloth opens a connection to each instance. Connecting is passing, failing is critical.
agents_page.check_type_ttl_hint: Each instance reports pass, warn or fail itself. Missing the TTL is critical.

agents_page.identity_type_api_key_hint: The agent sends the secret as X-API-Key.
agents_page.identity_type_basic_auth_hint: The agent sends the username and secret as HTTP basic auth.
agents_page.identity_type_client_credentials_hint: The agent exchanges the client ID and secret at /api/v1/public/oauth/token for a short-lived bearer token.
agents_page.identity_token_ttl_hint: How long an issued token stays valid, between 60 and 86400.
agents_page.identity_secret_hint: Optional. Set the secret the agent will send, or leave empty.
